## Summary

A clear and concise description of what went wrong.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Open Tower Studio (`index.html` or live demo)
2. Go to Master Step `...` (e.g., `01 · Site`, `02 · Open cabinet`, `03 · Power`, `04 · Aim & Connect`, `05 · Go on air`)
3. Select vendor / generation / configuration `...`
4. Click `...`
5. Observe error

What should have happened?

## Actual Behavior

What happened instead? Include any browser console messages if visible.
